# ThaparGenie

> Answers to questions about Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology (TIET), each
> linked to the official document or page it came from.

Students sign in and ask in plain English or Hinglish about admissions, fees, hostels,
the academic calendar, courses, rules and campus life. Answers are written only from
official TIET documents and pages, and cite them.

- [Home](https://thapargenie.divyanshuagrahari.dev/): what the service does.
- [Privacy notice](https://thapargenie.divyanshuagrahari.dev/privacy): what is stored and for how long.

Asking questions needs a signed-in account. There is no public API.
